      SUBROUTINE SMA1B (KIJ, INDEX, ICODE, IFFILE,
     1  FACTOR)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KIJ(6,6), FACTOR
      INTEGER INDEX, ICODE, IFFILE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(6,6,2,2)
      INTEGER NCALLS, CPIVOT
      COMMON /CAPTURE/ KSTORE, NCALLS, CPIVOT
      REAL ECPT(100)
      INTEGER NECPT(100)
      EQUIVALENCE (NECPT(1), ECPT(1))
      COMMON /SMA1ET/ ECPT
      INTEGER IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, LEFT, FROWIC, LROWIC
      INTEGER NROWSC, TNROWS, JMAX, NLINKS, LINK(10)
      INTEGER IDETCK, DODET, NOGO
      COMMON /SMA1CL/ IOPT4, K4GGSW, NPVT, LEFT, FROWIC,
     1  LROWIC, NROWSC, TNROWS, JMAX, NLINKS, LINK, IDETCK,
     2  DODET, NOGO
      INTEGER I, J, IPVT, IBLK
      IF (FACTOR .NE. 0.0D0) RETURN
      IPVT = 0
      IF (NPVT .EQ. NECPT(2)) IPVT = 1
      IF (NPVT .EQ. NECPT(3)) IPVT = 2
      IF (IPVT .EQ. 0) RETURN
      IF (IPVT .NE. CPIVOT) THEN
        CPIVOT = IPVT
        NCALLS = 0
      END IF
      NCALLS = NCALLS + 1
      IBLK = NCALLS
      IF (IBLK .GT. 2) IBLK = 2
      DO 50 I = 1, 6
        DO 50 J = 1, 6
          KSTORE(I, J, IPVT, IBLK) = KIJ(I, J)
   50 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE GET_KMATRIX_ELBOW (KFULL)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION KFULL(12,12)
      DOUBLE PRECISION KSTORE(6,6,2,2)
      INTEGER NCALLS, CPIVOT
      COMMON /CAPTURE/ KSTORE, NCALLS, CPIVOT
      INTEGER I, J
      DO 100 I = 1, 6
        DO 100 J = 1, 6
          KFULL(I, J) = KSTORE(I, J, 1, 1)
          KFULL(I, J+6) = KSTORE(I, J, 1, 2)
          KFULL(I+6, J) = KSTORE(I, J, 2, 2)
          KFULL(I+6, J+6) = KSTORE(I, J, 2, 1)
  100 CONTINUE
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE TRANSD (ICSID, T)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICSID
      DOUBLE PRECISION T(9)
      T(1)=1.0D0; T(2)=0.0D0; T(3)=0.0D0
      T(4)=0.0D0; T(5)=1.0D0; T(6)=0.0D0
      T(7)=0.0D0; T(8)=0.0D0; T(9)=1.0D0
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE MESAGE (ICODE, IMSG, IPARM)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER ICODE, IMSG, IPARM
      WRITE(6,900) ICODE, IMSG
  900 FORMAT(' MESAGE called: code=', I6, ' msg=', I6)
      RETURN
      END
      SUBROUTINE HMAT (IELID)
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER IELID
      REAL FK
      COMMON /HMTOUT/ FK
      FK = 50.0
      RETURN
      END
